body_markdown:
DineSafe participated and presented at Georgia Environmental Health Association's Annual Education Conference (GEHA) on August 27th - 29th, 2024, in Lake Lanier, GA. We had the opportunity to discuss the innovative use of consumer crowdsourcing for monitoring real-time food safety trends. It was a pleasure to connect with the GEHA team, public health professionals, environmental health specialists, and more at Lake Lanier. A special thank you to Austin Haney, GEHA's Vice President, for his exceptional leadership and support in ensuring our seamless involvement and integration. Read more about the GEHA Annual Conference[here](https://geha-online.wildapricot.org/event-5621391) !


DineSafe founder Patrick Quade (left) with Georgia Environmental Health Association's Vice President Austin Haney (right)


The GEHA, a key non-profit entity, focuses on enhancing the professional growth of those involved in environmental health across various sectors such as government, academia, and industry. Additionally, they are responsible for the well-being of approximately 11 million people. GEHA aims to foster training, support, and certification in the field, thereby playing an indispensable role in protecting public health and safety through a holistic approach to environmental health.


Georgia Environmental Health Association's Annual Education Conference Main Presentation Hall


Working closely yet independently from the Georgia Department of Public Health and the Georgia Department of Agriculture, GEHA undertakes a wide range of educational and advocacy activities. These initiatives aim not only to improve community well-being but also to promote sustainable practices among businesses and industries throughout Georgia.


DineSafe Founder Patrick Quade's Speaker Badge


GEHA is committed to advancing public and environmental health through education, community involvement, and professional development. The organization prioritizes openness and the regular update of environmental health information to reflect its evolving nature.


Highlighting its dedication, GEHA annually hosts this three-day conference focused on education, networking, and idea sharing—a testament to GEHA's commitment to public health and safety. This event was supported by leading entities in environmental health and technology, such as the Association of Food and Drug Officials. Our participation in the conference greatly aligns with our continued commitment to enhancing public health and safety.


We are immensely grateful for the opportunity to have participated in their annual event and eagerly look forward to reconnecting with the new partnerships we have formed for future collaborations.


For additional information about our upcoming and previous presentations, please visit our events page[here](https://dinesafe.com/events/) .
